name: Polydecene
description: Polydecene (CAS 37309-58-3 ), also referred to commercially as decene homopolymer, is a synthetic hydrocarbon polymer used as a base fluid and viscosity modifier in lubricant formulations. Its controlled molecular weight distribution makes it a functional building block for high-performance lubricant systems. This material is highly valued where thermal stability and low volatility are procurement priorities. In automotive and industrial lubricant blending, it serves as a base stock component in gear oils, compressor oils, and engine oil formulations requiring consistent viscometric performance. Metalworking fluid formulators incorporate it into cutting and forming lubricants where film strength and oxidative stability directly affect tool life and surface finish quality. It provides reliable performance across a wide range of temperature conditions. In the oil and gas sector, it is used in drilling fluid additives and downhole lubricants where synthetic hydrocarbon base fluids outperform mineral oil under high-pressure conditions. These applications rely on the polymer's inherent chemical stability. Rheology modifiers based on this polymer are also blended into grease formulations to control consistency and flow behavior. This ensures that the final product maintains its structural integrity during heavy-duty industrial operations and mechanical stress. The product is supplied as a clear to pale yellow viscous liquid, with commercial grades differentiated primarily by viscosity grade. Technical-grade material is the standard offering, with viscosity specifications typically ranging to suit light through heavy applications. Bulk liquid and intermediate bulk container (IBC) supply formats are standard for industrial buyers.
